# Best power banks for a MacBook Pro

Match the power bank's wattage to your model. A 14" Pro fast-charges at about 96W or more, and a 16" Pro needs 140W (PD 3.1) for the fastest speeds. Keep the capacity under 100Wh so it's allowed in carry-on. Expect roughly 70-75% of a 16" battery per full power bank, because some power is lost in transfer ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2955100/ecoflow-rapid-pro-27k-power-bank-300w-review-macbook-battery-pack.html)).

## My picks

**Best overall: Anker Prime Power Bank (26K, 300W)**
- It has 99.75Wh capacity, two 140W USB-C ports, and 300W total output, so it can fast-charge two MacBooks at once.
- It recharges in about 15 minutes to 50% using both USB-C ports at 250W.
- Macworld rates it best overall, and WIRED also recommends it.
- The price was $229.99 when reviewed, with some retailers at about $199.98. It has no built-in cable, but a 240W USB-C cable is included.
- [Macworld's roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html) links to current deals.

**Best with a built-in cable: EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K (300W)**
- It has 99.54Wh capacity, a retractable cable rated up to 140W, and two 140W ports plus two 65W ports.
- In Macworld's testing it recharged a 14" MacBook Pro about 1.2 times.
- It lists at $219.99, though Macworld's price tracker showed $109.99 at one retailer, so check current pricing.
- [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/2955100/ecoflow-rapid-pro-27k-power-bank-300w-review-macbook-battery-pack.html)

**Best value: ReelCharge ReelPro (27,000mAh, 200W)**
- It has a built-in cable that delivers up to 140W, and it costs about $120.
- WIRED likes it, but ReelCharge is a new brand. It does come with a 3-year warranty.
- [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)

**Budget 100W option: Baseus Blade H1 (20,000mAh, 100W)**
- It costs $89.99 (price verified Oct 21, 2026) and includes a 100W cable.
- It's about 74Wh, so it's airline-legal. That's plenty for a 14" Pro but won't give a 16" Pro its full 140W speed.
- It recharges in about 1.5 hours.
- [Buy at Baseus via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-blade-h1-100w-20000mah) (affiliate link, per the page's disclosure)

## Which one?
- **16" MacBook Pro:** the Anker Prime or EcoFlow RAPID Pro. To get 140W, use Apple's USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable, or a Thunderbolt 5 cable on M4/M5 models ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/819438/best-macbook-usb-c-charger.html)).
- **14" MacBook Pro:** any of these will work. The ReelPro or Baseus saves money.

Prices change often, so check the retailer's current price before buying.
